title: User-centric Subjective Leaderboard by Customizable Reward Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Kendall correlations between LLM rankings produced by conventional reward models and rankings generated using explicit criteria for conciseness versus elaboration, demonstrating a systematic preference for longer responses.

Evaluating LLM-as-a-judge performance on bidirectional preference modeling test sets (with reversed criteria labels) to show performance disparities caused by models internalizing aggregated general public preferences rather than adhering to specified subjective evaluation criteria.
